integrity: The analytic argument uses Itô isometry and a complete-square decomposition; independent mathematical priority and validation have not been established.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar periodic sampled-state feedback with control-linear actuator Brownian noise, prescribed measurable activation window, bounded periodic coefficients, invertible actuator effectiveness and unrestricted square-integrable hold amplitude; not a result for general matrix plants, fixed input bounds, uncertain samples or observation noise.
title: Duty-cycle invariance and a sharp zero-order-hold penalty under sampled actuator noise
